summary: Build practical SOC and SIEM skills with applied labs, detection mapping, and reporting tools. Enquire now.
lede: Security Operations Centre and SIEM Management gives you a structured approach to monitoring events, triaging alerts, investigating incidents, and supporting response decisions. Through applied exercises, you practise building a log source inventory, prioritising alerts, tuning correlation logic, and defining clear escalation criteria. The course also covers detection mapping, incident handoffs, SOC performance reporting, SOAR concepts, threat intelligence feeds, and AI-assisted alert enrichment. You will learn practical ways to strengthen detection coverage, manage noisy or incomplete data, preserve evidence quality, and communicate incident status clearly.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for security professionals who monitor alerts, investigate suspicious activity, tune detections, and report SOC performance to leadership.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of networking concepts, basic cybersecurity terminology, and common event log types from endpoints, servers, firewalls, or cloud platforms. Familiarity with one SIEM platform, even at a user level, will help you move faster, but it is not mandatory. No coding/programming is required for completion, although you should be comfortable working with dashboards, filters, queries, and incident records in a digital SOC environment. Advanced concepts such as SIEM correlation design, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and SOAR orchestration are taught at an operational application level, with hands-on practice in structured exercises.
